title: Security of Deep Research Agents: Attack Surface, Defenses, Benchmarks, and Agenda Seeding against Research Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20045v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep research and agentic search agents autonomously retrieve content from the open web and generate reports with citations, and their outputs are often taken directly as research conclusions. This paper systematizes security research in this area along four stages, namely retrieval, planning, evidence integration, and report generation. We present a unified threat model, a taxonomy of attacks and defenses, and a review of evaluation benchmarks, and we align the area dimension by dimension with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) poisoning, prompt injection, and generative engine optimization (GEO). Coding 34 primary studies shows that only 26.5% of them involve the planning stage, and none performs an end-to-end poisoning evaluation on commercial products. translated_title: 深度研究智能体的安全性：攻击面、防御、基准测试以及针对研究规划的议程植入
translated_abstract: 深度研究和智能体搜索代理会自主地从开放网络中检索内容，并生成带有引用的报告，其输出往往被直接当作研究结论。本文沿着四个阶段对该领域的安全研究进行了系统化梳理，即检索、规划、证据整合和报告生成。我们提出了统一的威胁模型、攻击与防御的分类体系，并对评估基准进行了综述，同时将该领域与检索增强生成（RAG）投毒、提示注入和生成式引擎优化（GEO）进行逐维度对齐。对34项主要研究的编码分析表明，其中仅有26.5%涉及规划阶段，且没有任何研究对商业产品进行端到端的投毒评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了议程植入攻击，攻击者不编写任何指令，仅引入一个虚构的评估指标即可实施攻击。在3,520个沙盒环境中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文系统梳理了深度研究智能体的安全研究，提出统一的威胁模型与攻击防御分类，并创新性地提出了无需注入任何指令、仅通过引入虚构评估指标就能操纵研究规划的“议程植入”攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper systematizes security research on deep research agents with a unified threat model and attack-defense taxonomy, and introduces the novel agenda seeding attack, which manipulates research planning without writing any instructions by merely injecting a fictitious evaluation metric.
